findings.title: Withheld-origin human comment is not bound to its published criterion and seeds linked repair work on any ordinary criterion
findings.reason: The review invents a criterion binding on an origin-only human annotation. ProofRiskReview intentionally identifies delivery+assessment+origin+original index and does not promise a criterion. Its own reproduction admits requestChanges fails closed under v4. The asserted later risk at index0 belongs to a different report ID/origin and cannot relabel an immutable existing report. No extra criterion or invented obligation is appropriate.
